summary: v52i — Fixed escrow password reset (account tokens were being posted to the signatory endpoint), added legacy-claim auto-provisioning so approved magic-link-era institutions recover access via Forgot password, added Escrow Institution option to the unified /forgot-password page, reset now flips account to verified. Rebuilt v52i bundles.

verification.legacy_claim_roundtrip: Seeded approved institution with NO account -> POST /auth/forgot -> account auto-created (verified, legacy_claim=true, institution linked) -> reset token present -> POST /auth/reset 200 -> POST /auth/login 200 with institution attached.
verification.no_enumeration: Unknown email returns 200 ok without creating anything.
verification.browser_reset_page: Real token via /escrow/login?reset=1&token=... -> reset toast -> login with new password -> /escrow/me. Screenshot /app/test_reports/iteration_77_reset_login.png.
verification.forgot_page_ui: Escrow radio present, submit renders sent panel. Screenshot /app/test_reports/iteration_77_forgot.png.
